body:
Norges Bank Investment Management has agreed to form a new strategic partnership with Ares Real Estate focused on investing in, developing, and operating logistics properties across Europe.

Under the agreement, Norges Bank Investment Management will make an equity commitment of €1.5 billion and hold a 96% ownership interest in the partnership.

The venture will target logistics warehouse properties located near major European population and consumer centers. Investments are expected to be concentrated primarily across Western and Southern Europe, including the United Kingdom.

Ares’ integrated logistics operating platform, Marq Logistics, will be responsible for sourcing, developing, and managing the properties acquired through the partnership.

The agreement expands Norges Bank Investment Management’s existing exposure to the logistics sector. The fund manager currently owns approximately €11.5 billion of logistics properties across Europe and North America.

The new partnership is designed to provide additional opportunities to invest in both existing logistics properties and development projects alongside Ares, which has an established presence across major European logistics markets.

Logistics real estate has become an important component of institutional real estate portfolios as investors seek exposure to properties supporting e-commerce, supply chains, and distribution networks serving major metropolitan areas.

The partnership gives Norges Bank Investment Management access to Ares’ sourcing, development, and operating capabilities while providing the venture with significant long-term equity capital to pursue acquisitions and development opportunities across multiple European markets.

Norges Bank Investment Management is the investment management division of Norges Bank and is responsible for managing the Government Pension Fund Global. Its unlisted investments in real estate and renewable energy infrastructure are made and managed through subsidiary structures established by Norges Bank.

The agreement establishing the partnership was signed on October 20, 2026.

“Ares is an experienced investor and developer with a strong presence in Europe’s major logistics markets, and has a good track record of creating value for its investment partners. This partnership gives us access to both standing assets and development opportunities, and we look forward to building a long-lasting partnership.”

Alex Knapp, Global Head Of Real Estate At Norges Bank Investment Management
